d: The Kailasanatha Temple in Ellora, Maharashtra, stands as the world’s largest monolithic structure, carved out of a single hill of basalt rock. Sculpted over 1,200 years ago by the Rashtrakuta dynasty, this rock-cut masterpiece leaves visitors in awe of its scale and intricacy. Spanning 300 feet in length and rising 96 feet high, this ancient temple complex has astounded generations with its artistry and ambition.
